RESTRICTING COMPETITION JUSTIFICATION

IAW FAR 12.102 (a)

1. REQUIRING AGENCY: DOJ /Bureau of Prisons, FCI La Tuna

2. NATURE/DESCRIPTION OF ACTION BEING APPROVED: Urgent repair of Main Power Plant boilers that supply steam power to the institution.

3. DESCRIPTION OF SUPPLIES OR SERVICES REQUIRED TO MEET THE AGENCY'S NEEDS: Agency requires services from a certified technician to repair two of three boilers that have developed severe leaks. The estimated value of requirement is $82,790.00

4. AUTHORITY: FAR 12.102 (a) & FAR 6.1032

5. DEMONSTRATION THAT THE PROPOSED CONTRACTOR'S UNIQUE QUALIFICATIONS OR

THE NATURE OF THE ACQUISITION REQUIRES USE OF THE AUTHORITY CITED:

FCI La Tuna staff identified major leaks in the boiler system at the Main Power Plant that supplies steam to the entire institution, including operations for Food Service and Laundry. As a result, only one of three boilers is currently operational. FCI La Tuna relies on the Power Plant to generate and distribute steam heat throughout the institution. Because the powerhouse provides the sole source of steam heat for the institution, the leaks in two to three of the boilers created an urgent operational risk requiring immediate corrective action. Local certified vendors were contacted to assess the leaks and identify the specialized repairs needed. After assessment, only one vendor, Wyler Industrial Works, possessed the necessary technical expertise, and immediate availability to perform the work within the timeframe required to maintain safe and continuous operation of the boiler system. Given the urgent nature of the repair and the critical need to restore two of the three boilers to operate the powerhouse, it was determined that only one source could meet the Government's immediate operational needs. Failure to complete the repairs promptly would result in significant operational disruption and substantial additional costs for the government.
